title: tools/mem backend is OmniGraph 0.16.0 (release binary); graph lives at /home/user/.plutus-mem, outside the repo
body: Measured 2026-11-25 (T4, D-02, L-13). Install that worked: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ModernRelay/omnigraph/main/scripts/install.sh | VERSION=v0.16.0 bash -> ~/.local/bin/omnigraph (sha256 of omnigraph-linux-x86_64.tar.gz 9b080f761e3d0ec7679a5cb60d479ba2e8982bf9797420a2b75ce99c2b029779). No source build was needed. After a container reset: run that install, then tools/mem/mem rebuild (init + sync memory/*.md + replay memory/graph_log.jsonl). Embeddings are off; search is BM25 full-text. The proxy answers 403 on github.com/ModernRelay/omnigraph/releases/latest (HTML page) but the release asset download itself returns 200.
